description_en: Queries the delivery status of the SMS verification code. You can query only the delivery status of the SMS verification code that is sent by calling corresponding API operations
description_zh: 查询短信验证码发送状态（仅能查询短信认证API版本的发送记录）
name: QuerySendDetails

parameters.help_en:
The date when the text message was sent. You can query text messages that were sent within the last 30 days.

Specify the date in the yyyyMMdd format. Example: 20181225
parameters.help_zh:
短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式为：yyyyMMdd，例如20181225
parameters.name: send_date

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the business, which is provided by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh: 业务的唯一标识号，由阿里云提供
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page on which you are reading the text message. Pages start from page 1. The value of this parameter cannot exceed the maximum page number
parameters.help_zh: 当前读取第几页消息，从1开始递增，读取消息时不可超过最大页数
parameters.name: current_page
